svg.title: MachLume Studio
svg.desc: Native Windows app that profiles AI workloads across CPU, GPU and NPU. Animated roofline chart: LLM decode sits on the memory-bound slope, prefill on the compute roof, and the predicted point converges onto the measured one. 3.13 TOPS FP16 on an Intel AI Boost NPU; 2.4% prefill and 3.8% decode prediction error on 16 Llama 3 8B runs; 54 Rust tests.
